name: agent-authoring-decisions
body:
Agentic authoring: `kalide init` and `kalide init-library` seed a project-local `AGENTS.md` giving coding agents full, accurate detail of the kalide deck/template format. LOCKED DECISIONS [with user]: (1) seed scope — all three scaffolding commands write an `AGENTS.md`: no-arg `kalide init` (embedded hello-seed deck), `kalide init <path>` (external-library deck form) and `kalide init-library <path>` (new template library); deck forms get a deck-author guide, init-library gets a library/template-author guide. (2) what ships — `AGENTS.md` ONLY, a single project-root Markdown file per project; no `.opencode/agents/` role files and no machine-readable schema file. (3) static seed file, drift-guarded — the guide is an authored file embedded in internal/scaffold (the deck guide inside the existing `seed/` tree copied by writeHelloSeed, a comparable embedded file for init-library read like DefaultThemeCSS/mustReadSeed), written verbatim by init; a build/test-time self-test guards against drift from the real format, modeled on validateSeed() + package init() in internal/scaffold/helloseed.go. (4) the guide is unbranded (no EY), text-only, offline, and never a template asset.

Guide-variant decision [autonomous, within locked decision 1]: the two deck forms share ONE identical deck-author guide. Justification: the format (deck layout, kalide.yaml keys, frontmatter, the resolved `templates/` layout, template.yaml schema, layout language, themes, media, validation and CLI) is identical whether the library is the local `templates/` or a configured external path; only the library location and the absence of a starter slide in the external form differ, and the guide states both in a short note. One shared file is a single source of truth and minimises drift surface. The library form gets a DISTINCT library/template-author guide (library-agent-guide), since its reader authors templates/libraries, not decks.

Tier-4 deferral: the new embedded guide file(s) (the deck `AGENTS.md` seed and the library `AGENTS.md` seed) and any new Go helper that reads the library-form guide do NOT exist yet. The spec's solution tier therefore ends at code FQNs that resolve in today's graph (internal/scaffold.Init, writeHelloSeed, InitExternal, InitLibrary, DefaultThemeCSS; internal/cli.runInit, runInitLibrary). The plan-writer declares the new files/functions as planned Implementation nodes at plan time; no tier-4/planned node is created here. DefaultThemeCSS is included as implemented-by solution.component.agent-guide only as the existing library-form embedded-seed read (`mustReadSeed`) that the new guide read will mirror [autonomous].

Structure [autonomous]: the four new requirements are children of requirements.requirement.project-templates (feature `project-templates`), grouping the format-reference requirements with project-templates; the deck guide is tied to the seed requirements it amends via depends-on (cli-init, cli-init-minimal-seed). The deck guide contract is modeled as the domain VALUE domain.value.agent-guide inside domain.group.authoring, and the library guide as domain.value.library-agent-guide inside domain.group.templating (each a descriptor of its format domain, like domain.value.format / domain.value.library-manifest — not business entities); values cannot carry realised-by (solution.note.spine-values-and-tier4), so each realises through its containing group, and the two groups plus the scaffold services are realised-by solution.component.agent-guide.

Library-layout conflict resolved [autonomous, FLAGGED — coordinator should confirm]: init-library's root IS the library (templates) root, and templates-dir-layout rejects any top-level entry that is not `library.yaml`/`slides/`/`sections/`/`themes/`/`media/` (confirmed in internal/template/loadlibrary.go checkTopLevelLayout). Writing `AGENTS.md` at the library root would therefore make a freshly created library fail templates-dir-validation, contradicting init-library's load-cleanly AC. Resolution: requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout is amended to permit the single inert root entry `AGENTS.md`, and requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout records the exception as an atomic, testable requirement (note fix-init-library-agents-md). The deck root has no unknown-entry rule, so the deck guide needs no exception. Alternative if rejected: write the library guide outside the library root (but that breaks the 'travels with the shared library' intent of global.constraint.template-library-shareable).

Constraint note [autonomous, reconciled in feedback-3]: the local constraint solution.constraint.agent-guide-unbranded-inert attaches to solution.component.agent-guide, stating the guide must stay unbranded/format-accurate/inert. The embedded library-form guide is written by `kalide init-library`, not by the no-arg `kalide init` seed, and the external `kalide init <path>` form writes the deck guide too; the two global constraints that authorise embedded scaffold content (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets, global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary) previously named only "the minimal `kalide init` seed scaffold" and were therefore narrower than the deck + library guide artifacts. Both were amended to explicitly permit the static, unbranded, text-only `AGENTS.md` scaffold guide files written verbatim by all three scaffolding commands (`kalide init`, `kalide init <path>`, `kalide init-library`), without opening the door to any template/theme/media embedding (note fix-agent-guide-global-constraints); requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded is unchanged. The local bound keeps the guide's unbranded/inert contract attached to the specific solution node.

Amendments: cli-init and cli-init-minimal-seed bodies now state both deck forms write `AGENTS.md` (note fix-init-agents-md); init-library and templates-dir-layout record the guide and its layout exception (note fix-init-library-agents-md); solution.component.init-seed and solution.component.cli-commands bodies name `AGENTS.md` (note fix-agent-guide-solution); both embedded guides are now named as permitted embedded scaffold content (not template assets) in global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets and global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary (note fix-agent-guide-global-constraints).
